node_modules_rationale: Each task workspace contains a `node_modules` symlink pointing to the single shared cache. This lets `npm test` resolve `./node_modules/.bin/jest`, `babel-jest`, `@exercism/babel-preset-javascript`, `@jest/globals`, and `core-js` offline with zero extra env vars, while redo.py skips `node_modules` in workspace snapshots/archives and restores the origin symlink during `kind='command'` acceptance.
rule: Source: exercism/javascript exercises/practice/*. Require .meta/config.json, .meta/proof.ci.js (reference), exactly one *.spec.js test file, exactly one solution stub .js file, and .docs/instructions.md. Exclude exercises requiring npm dependencies/devDependencies beyond the repo root package.json devDependencies (jest/babel toolchain) or network access. Enable Exercism CI test markers in *.spec.js (\bx(test|it)\( -> test(, \bxdescribe\( -> describe(, matching scripts/helpers.mjs without altering test.skip/describe.skip). Validate offline via `npm test --silent` using the repo's babel.config.js, jest.config.js, and shared node_modules cache: (a) reference solution passes (exit 0, >=1 test passed), (b) starter stub fails at least one test (exit != 0, status ok). Order survivors ascending by sha256(slug + ':redo-js-2026-11-20') and take the first 34.
